name: Baeloth Barrityl, Entertainer — goads the opponents' creatures with less power than Baeloth has now
notes: Memory: project_source_compared_subjects_judged_after_layer_7_2026-10-16. 'Creatures your opponents control with power less than Baeloth Barrityl's power are goaded': 'with power less than this card's power' was not in the filter vocabulary, so it became a required subtype and nothing was goaded. The subject now compares with Baeloth's power as it is now, and the trait is judged after layer 7, so the +1/+1 counter (layer 7d) that makes Baeloth 3/6 counts: Grizzly Bears (2) is goaded, Hill Giant (3) is not, and nothing of Baeloth's controller is.
